description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for reading General Ledger (GL) closure data within the Fineract accounting module. It declares methods for retrieving all GL closures associated with an office and for retrieving a specific GL closure by its ID.

classes.name: GLClosureReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface that provides methods to read GL closure data, including retrieving all closures for an office and retrieving specific closures by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllGLClosures
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GLClosureData objects for all GL closures associated with a given office.

methods.name: retrieveGLClosureById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GLClosureData object by its unique closure ID.
